children: BioNTech reported first global Phase 2 data for pumitamig plus docetaxel in advanced NSCLC after IO+chemo, showing 36.7% confirmed ORR in 30 evaluable patients and median PFS of 6.9 months in 50 treated, with manageable safety.

AI Analyst View
cORR 36.7% (n=30 evaluable)
Response rate appears higher than historical docetaxel alone, suggesting added activity.
Median PFS 6.9 months (n=50)
Exceeds historical ~3.6–3.9 months for docetaxel post IO+chemo, if confirmed.
DCR 90.0% (n=30 evaluable)
High disease control may translate to longer benefit; needs durability data.
Responses across PD-L1 levels
Activity in low PD-L1 could broaden addressable population.
Squamous cORR 57.1%; non-sq 30.4%
Signal in squamous, a tough setting, may be a differentiator.
Manageable safety; no new signals
Supports advancement into ongoing Phase 3s; de-risks safety profile.

An early median progression-free survival of 6.9 months was observed
